summary: No code correction was justified. The upstream issue records the same incorrect two-image semantics with Hugging Face MllamaForConditionalGeneration and cites Meta's statement that Llama 3.2 Vision does not reliably support multiple images. Current SGLang main still marks its per-image cross-attention mask as a TODO, but changing it would be speculative without evidence that it fixes a failure also present in the reference implementation.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact reported regression target on the prepared checkout; test discovery fails because TestMllamaServer is commented out on current main. Raw output is in exact-reproduction.log.

tests.command: curl https://huggingface.co/api/models/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct and scan the prepared Hugging Face cache
tests.what_was_measured: The repository is manual-gated at revision 9eb2daaa8597bf192a8b0e73f848f3a102794df5 and the prepared runtime has no cached checkpoint, blocking local SGLang and Transformers full-model comparison.

tests.command: rocm-smi --showproductname --showuniqueid --showmeminfo vram; prepared Python torch device query
tests.what_was_measured: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 is visible through PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This is environment inventory, not Mllama execution.

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned gfx950 device was detected, but required gated Mllama weights were absent, so no issue-specific model execution occurred.
remaining_limitations: The gated meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct weights were unavailable in the prepared runtime.
Current main comments out TestMllamaServer as flaky, so the exact historical server regression no longer reaches server startup.
The original semantic output was not locally reproduced; upstream evidence shows the same behavior in Transformers.
SGLang's Mllama per-image cross-attention mask remains unimplemented, but no reference-quality evidence ties that TODO to a fix for this architecture-level behavior.
